text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, April?! I've avenged
you!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
If they have the nerve to hold the
Satsuki Sho in
your month ever again,
I've got your back!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
These fists will rage just as fiercely for
your sake
next year!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
She charges off before I can inform her
that only
classic year runners can
participate in the Satsuki
Sho...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
